testId: tests/admin/DashboardPage/DashboardTest.spec.ts > BMP-36 TC3: Dashboard header shows Dashboard, Users, Products, Orders, Alerts

scenario.summary: The project's Admin account (role Admin on qa) signs in on the storefront, lands on the BI WORLDWIDE Web Admin Dashboard (/admin), and the header shows the navigation sections Dashboard, Users, Products, Orders and Alerts.
steps: Open the storefront sign-in page (config webstoreURL, /login)
Enter the Admin account's username and password (config adminUsername / adminPassword, from env ADMIN_USERNAME / ADMIN_PASSWORD) and sign in
Check that the Web Admin Dashboard (/admin) is shown
Read the navigation sections in the Web Admin header
stateChanges: A session is started for the Admin account
assertions: The Web Admin Dashboard (/admin) is shown after sign-in
The header shows the sections Dashboard, Users, Products, Orders and Alerts (labels fixed by AC3 and BMP-82; order not fixed by the story)
evidence: Jira BMP-36 AC3 and test case TC3 (work/stories/BMP-36/input/BMP-36-story.md); BMP-82 header; no FRD
